description: Source of truth for the development-tools GitHub Release channel. Lists the include globs (grouped by category) and exclude patterns that scripts/buildDevToolsRelease.js resolves into a deterministic, content-addressed toolset. Compiled output (out/**) must be built with `npm run compile` before packaging. Byte-for-byte edits to this file change which files ship and therefore the release content digest.

categories.description: Node CLI tools under scripts/ (risk ledger, release readiness, traceability/requirements audits, etc.) plus the Windows runtime-matrix PowerShell helpers invoked by runWindowsRuntimeMatrix.js.
Requirements and traceability documents plus the compiled requirements manifest.
Agent customization surfaces: AGENTS.md and .github skills/prompts/instructions/agents.
